name: Subliminal Region
original_name: サブリミナルレジオン
source:
2018, the world of after a lapse of eight years from the faith collapse.
Three young sorcerers belonging to the Ministry of Defense Special Armed Forces-Michiharu Yoshimuro, Kazuya Inaba, and Mizuki Kurauchi were tasked with resolving the square-related cases that occurred around the same time.
As they perform their duties, the members will remember their own past and face it again.
On the other hand, the Special Armed Forces Headquarters found a strange common point in each mission--

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1393550/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
2018年，距离信仰崩坏已经过去八年。
隶属于防卫省特殊武装部的三名年轻方术师，吉室道治、稻叶一矢与仓内瑞纪，受命处理几乎同时发生的方阵相关事件。
执行任务的过程中，他们将重新回忆、面对各自的过去。
另一方面，特殊武装部总部，发现每项任务之间存在一个奇怪的共同点——

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1393550/]Steam[/url]]
